image_description: A tri-fold restaurant menu displayed flat, featuring three distinct panels with structured text. The left panel contains a logo and appetizer/drink sections, the middle panel lists entrees, and the right panel details desserts or additional items. The design uses a cream background with dark green headers and orange/brown body text.
